justification: New CI/pre-commit gate plus a behaviour fix in the audit flagger (more rules flagged for human reading)

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any tracked source file contains a C0 control character other than tab/newline/CR, or IN_PLACE stops matching 'In <Place>'
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main scripts/address_audit/flag_packets.py:28 IN_PLACE holds two 0x08 bytes and does not match 'In Ashfield, the setback is 3 m' (test_flag_packets_in_place_pattern_matches_again red there); lint_control_chars on main's tree reports 2 files.

pre_impl.existing_data: none — reads tracked file bytes only
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: a binary file with a source extension would be flagged; none exist in the tree today (scan clean)
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: every commit and every CI run after this merge

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any tracked source file contains a C0 control character other than tab/newline/CR, or IN_PLACE stops matching 'In <Place>'

functions.name: main
functions.input: tracked or staged file paths with source extensions
functions.output: exit 1 with file:line per control character, else exit 0
functions.if_none: no files to check returns OK and exit 0

break_it.scenario: a fixture or data file legitimately contains a form feed or control byte
break_it.what_happens: the lint would block an unrelated commit touching that file
break_it.how: none exist today; such a file would need its extension excluded deliberately
break_it.repro: add   to a .md file and commit

break_it.scenario: the flagger now flags 'In <Place>' rules it silently skipped
break_it.what_happens: more rules go to human reading; audit counts move
break_it.how: intended: those are place-limited rules (DQ-143 class)
break_it.repro: python scripts/address_audit/flag_packets.py on a saved packet

break_it.scenario: a regex escape written through a shell heredoc in future work
break_it.what_happens: a word boundary turns into a byte that never matches, silently
